name: Heal Regen
description: Heal over time: a gentle green aura that breathes in three soft pulses, leaf-like motes drifting up on a 3 s seamless loop.

metadata.analysis: Regen: 3.0 s seamless loop, three soft pulses, green palette, leaf motes instead of feathers, the swirl carried by a vortex on the motes rather than a ribbon (a trail cannot wrap a loop seam).
metadata.target: invisible humanoid capsule, 1.8 m tall, radius 0.35 m, standing at the origin
